description: Strong Delegate Victory Delivers Clear Mandate. Colorado Republicans Unite Behind Marx to Take Back Colorado.DENVER, CO — In a commanding display of Republican unity, Victor Marx won 39% of delegates at the Colorado Republican State Assembly, earning ballot position for the governor's race by a decisive margin.Tonight’s result is one of the strongest showings in recent Colorado Republican primary history and sends an unmistakable signal: THE PARTY'S GRASSROOTS BASE HAS FOUND ITS CANDIDATE.Having
title: VICTOR MARX WINS 39% OF DELEGATES AT COLORADO REPUBLICAN STATE ASSEMBLY SECURES BALLOT POSITION
